authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FC-RO invocation initial states from doctor-contract.v4 variants. It does not author pre-image digest sets. It does not author post-image digest sets. It does not author report bytes. It does not invent an Operational-metadata class root. It does not invent grant-journal bytes. It does not widen FC-RO's exception list. It does not execute FC-RO. It does not close OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING at FC-RO without inventing tree images, report goldens, a state-class assignment, or a grant-journal envelope. doctor v4 exactByteIntent pins a pre-image, a post-image, and report bytes; this catalog records the named variants as initial states. The three pinned artifacts remain unauthored.

doctorV4.fcRoExactByteIntent: A byte-for-byte image of a project tree and an install tree, digested entry-by-entry BEFORE the doctor invocation and again AFTER it, plus the doctor report emitted in between. The fixture pins all three artifacts: pre-image digest set, post-image digest set, report bytes.
variantsVerbatim: each of the seven degraded cases DEG-1..DEG-7 - the read-only property must hold precisely where repair is most tempting
with each consent class named, since consent to CA-1..CA-4 never departs from DP-1/DP-4
the audit-write-fails case: an invocation in which doctor's own Operational-metadata audit record cannot be written (no space, or access refused on doctor's own state)

namedNotRunnable.reason: doctor v4 theGrantJournalCollision: FC-RO is NOT YET RUNNABLE against a tree in which a DR-105 grant journal is written, and must not be made to pass by widening its exception list to admit journal bytes.
